cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin you have the CS line hooked up to.

*See also: [MAX7219 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [MAX7219 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#configuration-variables)*

intensity.docs:
**int**: The intensity with which the MAX7219 should drive the outputs. Range is from 0 (least intense) to 15 (the default).

*See also: [MAX7219 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#configuration-variables)*

num_chips.docs:
**int**: The number of chips you wish to use for daisy chaining. Defaults to `1`.

*See also: [MAX7219 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#configuration-variables)*

reverse_enable.docs:
**boolean**: For some displays the order of the chips is reversed so you'll see "56781234" instead of "12345678". This option will adjust the output to compensate. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [MAX7219 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#configuration-variables)*

spi_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [SPI Component](https://esphome.io/components/spi) if you want to use multiple SPI buses.

*See also: [MAX7219 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [MAX7219 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the MAX7219. See [Rendering Lambda](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#display-max7219_lambda) for more information.

*See also: [MAX7219 7-Segment Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/max7219#configuration-variables)*
